data.narrative:
Poolside, a Series B AI & Software company founded by Jason Warner and Eiso Kant, has raised $626M+ to date. Valuation assessment draws on a peer universe of 9 private companies and 1 public comparable (Palantir, PLTR), with direct stage peers including Scale AI ($29.0B), Physical Intelligence ($5.6B), and Black Forest Labs ($3.2B).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses total capital raised as a baseline proxy and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $1.2B. Peer-median analysis across the 3 same-sector, same-stage comparables produces a median valuation of $5.6B, with a range spanning $3.2B to $29.0B—reflecting substantial dispersion driven by Scale AI's outlier valuation relative to Physical Intelligence and Black Forest Labs.

The two methods triangulate to a range of $1.0B (low) to $6.4B (high), with a median of $3.4B. The stage-progression method anchors conservatively to capital deployed, while peer-median reflects market pricing of frontier AI companies at this development stage. Key uncertainties include the comparability of peer business models, the sustainability of current-stage AI company valuations, and Poolside's specific revenue trajectory and defensibility relative to the peer set.
